A '''sound dampener''',<ref name="EGWT" /> also known as a '''sound damper''',<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> was sonic dampening technology that was used to reduce [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] blast noise<ref name="EGWT" /> and quietened the noise made by [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="RASB" /> [[MM-s3 grenade launcher]]s incorporated sound dampeners, located around the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]].<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet's]] [[Overracer]] was fitted with passive sound dampeners.<ref name="RASB" />
